messages.content: Policy: unused items may be returned within 30 days of delivery. A receipt is required. Explain the return conditions to a customer in one sentence.

cases.expected: You can return unused items within 30 days of delivery if you have a receipt.
cases.rubric: The answer must include all three conditions: unused item, 30 days from delivery, and a receipt. Different wording is acceptable.
